items.title: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 4 Argon to Fairwind testers
items.body: Demis Hassabis and Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on 30 Sep, a frontier model for long-horizon coding, enterprise knowledge work and cyber defense, opening first to government and trusted defenders via the Fairwind Program. Introductory API price is $2 in / $10 out; output context rises to 1M tokens. Watch: paid API and AI Ultra availability, and whether third-party benches confirm DeepSWE 77.9% and Vals Index leadership.

items.title: Argon claims SOTA on DeepSWE, Vals, and 1M-token outputs
items.body: Koray Kavukcuoglu’s post says Argon is already used inside Google for C-to-Rust migrations (re2, libgav1, Fuchsia Zircon) and claims 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, #1 on Vals Index and AutomationBench 51.3%, plus 91.7% LVBench. Cyber path: no cyber guardrails for Fairwind testers; Wiz Scan for Good cited a healthcare exposure prior models missed. After intro pricing, list is $4/$20.

items.title: SynthID Bio watermarks functional AI-designed proteins
items.body: DeepMind posted SynthID Bio on 30 Sep: watermark methods that survive wet-lab synthesis on VEGF-A, SARS-CoV-2 RBD and PD-L1 binders without measured loss of hit rate or affinity. Ongoing work with Hie lab / Arc Institute to watermark an Evo 2 bacteriophage genome. Result is a biosecurity primitive, not a new binder family.

items.title: Hassabis: Argon first to Fairwind, then wider
items.body: Hassabis posted the launch and pointed at the Google blog. Quote verified on X: Very excited to announce Gemini 4 Argon, our new Frontier AI model, and a huge step forward across key capabilities. We’re focused on rolling it out responsibly starting with government and trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program today, before wider availability soon.

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: More Intelligence with Less Compute
items.body: Z.ai AutoClaw blog dated 1 Oct presents GLM-5.3-Flash as a native multimodal 320B/18B-active model trained on a 30T multimodal corpus, with hybrid sparse+linear attention. Company benches: Terminal Bench 2.1 84.3, DeepSWE v1.1 63.4, GDPval-AA v2 1773. Traffic claimed on Chinese accelerators under the Ox Alpha alias. Not independently scored here.

items.title: 智譜：根據2026年度股份激勵計劃授予獎勵
items.body: HKEX 2513 filing 30 Sep: Zhipu granted 1,222,934 H-share awards at RMB 0.1 purchase price; grant-day close 641.0 HKD. Vesting 4–63 months on performance conditions. Residual plan capacity 43,361,375 H shares. Filing is talent retention, not a model release.
